entities.name: Vytenis Lipkevičius

entities.summary: Vytenis Lipkevičius is a Lithuanian professional basketball player and team captain for Lietkabelis Panevėžys of the Lithuanian Basketball League (LKL). Standing at 1.98 m, he primarily plays at the small forward position.
